result.summary: Introduces a `with_sanitizer_env.py` helper script generated at build time that centralizes default environment variables and suppression paths for ASan, LSan, TSan, and UBSan. Updates CI scripts, fuzz runners, and the functional test framework to use these defaults automatically, and adds `enable_adaptive_delay=1` to the default TSan options.
result.problem: Default sanitizer options and suppression paths were hardcoded and duplicated across CI scripts, test runners, and documentation. Developers running sanitized binaries or tests locally had to manually export these options, and TSan ran without adaptive delay, potentially missing rare race conditions.
evidence: Author description: "Modifying the project's default requires modifying three places (docs, ci, and the fuzz runner)... enable https://clang.llvm.org/docs/ThreadSanitizer.html#adaptive-delay, which may help to find some kind of rare races more frequently."
result.card: Centralizes default sanitizer options and suppression paths into a generated with_sanitizer_env.py script, de-duplicating settings across CI scripts, test runners, and developer documentation. The defaults are automatically applied in functional tests and fuzz runs, while allowing explicit environment variables to take precedence. It also enables ThreadSanitizer adaptive delay (enable_adaptive_delay=1) by default to help detect rare race conditions.

risk.why: Touches only test runners, CI scripts, documentation, and test build configuration.
